title: The CANYON course: at the second choke the Tiger's gunner answers a 45 mm gun firing from the factory edge, then the commander rides head-out up the ravine toward the factory arena's T-34 patrol
input_audit: The course as the title menu's Canyon entry fields it (the two T-34 platoons on their beats, one 45 mm gun per choke sited by the field-of-fire probe, riflemen in the ruins, one crewman). Disclosed staging: the Tiger stands on the second choke's route where its gun sees it, 300 m out, facing up the ravine, its turret laid on the gun's shield, and the gun's crew has heard the fight; the platoons, the other guns and the riflemen keep their own states. The gunner fires twice with the disclosed staged_discharge fixture (a serviceable round seated, fired along the current lay); from 14 s the crewman climbs to the commander's post, opens the hatch, rides head-out and drives up the ravine. Every mark in the frame comes from the game; every level is the calibration's physical level at the ear through the live Audio graph.
historical_scope: The CANYON playtest course (docs/CANYON_COURSE_20260929.md): a composite of Stalingrad's balkas with a workers' settlement and a factory edge, held by a rifle battalion's 45 mm guns and two T-34 platoons; a playtest course, not a recorded engagement.
